features.name: Landing Page
features.description: Hero section with couple names (Xuân Tùng & Vân Anh), event details (tiệc đãi khách 08/06/2026, lễ thành hôn 09/06/2026, Sân đình thôn Gia Lương, Đông Anh, Hà Nội), Google Maps embed, and CTAs for RSVP and Our Story
features.evidence: Landing page hero, event cards, venue map embed, RSVP anchor section, and /story placeholder route implemented. Verified with pnpm lint, pnpm typecheck, and ./init.sh on 2026-05-05.

features.name: Our Story
features.description: Chapter-based scroll storytelling with 10 chapters covering 10 years (2016–2025), each with title, images, text, and Framer Motion animations (fade-in, slide-up, zoom)
features.evidence: Story page now renders 10 scroll-based chapters for 2016-2025 with Vietnamese placeholder copy, 39 image slots, reduced-motion-safe Framer Motion reveals, and lazy-loaded route shell. Verified with pnpm lint, pnpm typecheck, pnpm build, and ./init.sh on 2026-05-05.

features.name: Guest Personalization
features.description: URL-based guest personalization (?g=<id>), showing personalized greeting, message, and optional photo. Graceful fallback for unknown guests
features.evidence: Landing page now supports `?g=<guestId>` personalization with typed static guest lookup, personalized greeting/message, highlighted guest name in invitation text, optional photo rendering, and graceful fallback for unknown guests. Verified with pnpm lint, pnpm typecheck, pnpm build, and ./init.sh on 2026-05-05.

features.name: RSVP System
features.description: RSVP form with name + 2 event checkboxes (tiệc đãi khách 8/6, lễ thành hôn 9/6), submitting to Google Apps Script, with success/error feedback
features.evidence: ExecPlan created at docs/exec-plans/plans/feat-004-rsvp-system.md on 2026-05-05. Implementation pending.

features.name: Performance & Mobile Optimization
features.description: Image optimization (WebP/AVIF, Next.js Image), dynamic imports for heavy components, mobile-first responsive design, <2s initial load target
features.evidence: Added feat-005 product spec, guest image `sizes`, deferred-load venue map CTA, and reduced story placeholder animation density. Verified with pnpm lint, pnpm typecheck, and pnpm build on 2026-05-05. Full WebP/AVIF acceptance remains deferred until real production photos exist; see docs/exec-plans/tech-debt-tracker.md.
